'''Strike Force Xesh''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rangers]] squad that served the Rebellion during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point in the war, Strike Force Xesh was dispatched to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] to destroy an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Communications relay/Legends|communications relay]]. During the mission, they were forced to call in reinforcements to complete the task.<ref name="Task Force Xesh" />
